rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Seller Impersonation Pattern — DL-0186")`
`comment("Detects property sale by non-resident owner of vacant/unencumbered property")`
index=flame_realestate sourcetype=flame:property_transactions
  (transaction_type="sale_listing" OR transaction_type="title_transfer"
   OR transaction_type="deed_recording")
| eval non_resident = if(property_address != owner_mailing_address, 1, 0)
| eval unencumbered = if(mortgage_balance <= 0 OR isnull(mortgage_balance), 1, 0)
| eval vacant = if(occupancy_status="vacant", 1, 0)
| eval recent_contact_change = if(owner_contact_updated_days < 90, 1, 0)
| eval below_market = if(listing_price < assessed_value * 0.85, 1, 0)
| eval risk_score = non_resident + unencumbered + vacant + recent_contact_change + below_market
| where risk_score >= 3
| eval risk_level = case(
    risk_score >= 5, "critical",
    risk_score >= 4, "high",
    risk_score >= 3, "medium")
| eval listing_to_market_ratio = round(listing_price / assessed_value * 100, 1)
| table property_id, property_address, owner_name, assessed_value, listing_price,
        listing_to_market_ratio, occupancy_status, mortgage_balance,
        owner_contact_updated_days, non_resident, unencumbered, vacant,
        recent_contact_change, below_market, risk_score, risk_level
| sort - risk_score
rules.title: DL-0186: Seller Impersonation Pattern — Property Sale Initiated by Non-Resident Owner of Vacant/Unencumbered Property With Recent Contact Info Changes (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Fraudulent Deed Transfer Anomaly — DL-0187")`
`comment("Detects deed recording with AI generation indicators on inactive properties")`
index=flame_realestate sourcetype=flame:deed_recordings
  (recording_type="deed_transfer" OR recording_type="quitclaim_deed"
   OR recording_type="warranty_deed" OR recording_type="grant_deed")
| lookup notary_commission_db notary_commission_number, notary_state
    OUTPUT commission_status, commission_expiry
| eval notary_invalid = if(commission_status != "active"
    OR commission_expiry < now(), 1, 0)
| eval no_prior_activity = if(prior_recordings_5yr <= 0, 1, 0)
| eval vacant = if(property_occupancy_status="vacant", 1, 0)
| eval unencumbered = if(property_mortgage_balance <= 0
    OR isnull(property_mortgage_balance), 1, 0)
| eval ai_metadata_flag = if(document_metadata_risk_score >= 40, 1, 0)
| eval rapid_creation = if(document_creation_to_modification_sec < 60, 1, 0)
| eval composite_risk_score = (notary_invalid * 40)
    + (ai_metadata_flag * 30)
    + (no_prior_activity * 20)
    + (vacant * 15)
    + (unencumbered * 10)
    + (rapid_creation * 15)
| where composite_risk_score >= 40
| eval risk_level = case(
    composite_risk_score >= 80, "critical",
    composite_risk_score >= 60, "high",
    composite_risk_score >= 40, "medium")
| eval recommendation = if(composite_risk_score >= 60, "HOLD_RECORDING", "MANUAL_REVIEW")
| table recording_id, property_id, property_address, recording_type,
        recording_date, grantor_name, grantee_name, notary_name,
        notary_commission_number, commission_status, notary_invalid,
        document_metadata_risk_score, ai_metadata_flag, rapid_creation,
        prior_recordings_5yr, property_occupancy_status,
        composite_risk_score, risk_level, recommendation
| sort - composite_risk_score
rules.title: DL-0187: Fraudulent Deed Transfer Anomaly — Deed Recording With Document Metadata Anomalies (AI Generation Indicators) on Properties With No Prior Activity (SPLUNK)
